# Test Data Licenses

All test and evaluation papers must be openly licensed. No copyrighted PDFs may be included in the repository.

**Allowed Sources:**
- arXiv (various open licenses)
- PubMed Central Open Access Subset (CC-BY, CC0, etc.)
- Other CC-BY, CC0, or public domain sources

## Notes

- Each test PDF must document its source and license here
- Verify license allows redistribution before adding to repo
- Prefer CC-BY or CC0 licenses
- Include arXiv ID or PubMed Central ID for traceability
- Test papers should represent realistic academic documents (10-20 pages typical)
